title: MessageList windowing > opens with no more rows than fill the window, and draws the rows past the view's edges only after the first paint
cause: infra: the host stops scheduling the browser renderer process (the #2149/#671/#3221 hang class - CPU samples there read near-zero renderer CPU during the stall, ruling out a busy loop), cascading every subsequent screenshot in the shard into a timeout; not a product bug in MessageList or its test.
